content: cargo-llvm-cov: cargo llvm-cov --all-features --json --summary-only produces per-file and totals JSON. For time-based tracking, the summary JSON can be committed to .planning/baselines/coverage.json after each passing CI run. CI enforces: cargo llvm-cov --all-features --fail-under-lines <N> where N is the current baseline (floor). The existing CI job already uploads LCOV to Codecov which tracks trends. To add JSON-committed baseline: jq '.data[0].totals.lines.percent' output.json > reported-coverage.txt and compare to threshold stored in repo. This crate is already used in ci.yml of this project.
